notes.title: Winter Update
notes.content:
From Summer of 2018 to December 2020 - 100$ was the price of entry.

An audacious act. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29934088/54a25edda5083065aa9566e0d490aa534565d575.png[/img]

Summer of 2019: An unexplained spike of interest from Eastern Europe.

[url=https://imgur.com/bsjVJ6X]Добро пожаловать на борт[/url]

~

Since 2012, I've been recreating the places I've lived. In the previous version you were able to see 3 of these spaces from a stationary position. With this update you are now able to freely traverse through 5 places.

tags.feature: With this update you are now able to freely traverse through 5 places.

notes.title: February Update
notes.content:
A fresh build! Packaged with Unreal Engine 4.19 Preview 5 (!)

I've been shipping builds in development mode - this gives a bit of extra freedom to the console jockeys out there.

In October I mentioned a space to view those little colored dots we call pixels. It's in, but you'll need to travel there yourself.

Just hit the tilde key (~) and type "open hue" then use the keyboard to swap colors.

1 Red
2 Green
3 Blue
4 Yellow (R+G)
5 Cyan (G+B)
6 Magenta (R+B)
7 White
8 Gray
9 Black
0 Hueshift

tags.feature: - Added three new playable heroes: Queen of Pain, Slark, and Templar Assassin
- A new game mode has been added to matchmaking and offline play: Deathmatch.

notes.title: October Update
notes.content:
I'm having trouble finding a tone for these updates. I've been writing monthly updates on itch.io for 1.5 years, most of those read like a journal entry.

Lets just try to find our flow state. Where words come unmediated by conceptions of what a "Steam Update" should be. ;-)

I'm currently in limbo right now. Writing this from a basement living room. One path leads to Bellevue, the other leads East. There's a third path somewhere out there too...

In our HMDs each pixel is composed of 3 sub-pixels, Red Green Blue. When viewing different colors, you see different patterns in the pixels. I've created an environment for enjoyment and exploration of this phenomena.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29934088/b5caf34f81e0aa3a8b5727597b272546afec2d91.gif[/img]

When I attended SVVR, I got body-scanned by Artec3d. 5$ to download the .obj (Free to view on web)

Meet my flesh avatar - Monochrome GIF to shield you guys from the Uncanny Valley ;-)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29934088/83903c4787b4f5876d1e3ed4d1d41cc1714364bf.gif[/img]

I'm unsure how I'll incorporate this into SD. My entire ABOUT section is due for a redesign...

notes.title: September Update
notes.content:
First Steam update!

Now all of the INTRO experiences are grouped closer together.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29934088/f0fd45fa319cc58344010904392e958e5dab6e3e.png[/img]

Also, I've added blockouts of my Irvine and Duvall rooms. (Accessable through Anaheim Hills by looking at bedroom door, or out to the patio door) I'm not sure I'll be adding any more detail to these. They mostly serve as a way for me to remember the size and shape of places I've occupied.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29934088/c1a6ec9f180fd1d793c9fc6f6456363d4746800c.png[/img]

Hands-Free Quit/Return Functionality - Just look above you to initiate a return to the hub, or to quit if you're already in the hub. (This functionality unlocks after you've completed INTRO)
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29934088/a9ab0eacd5182a36c290e88b72fcfa812a06bfdb.gif[/img]

Random feature: Press CTRL + L at any time to show a Location Debug Widget!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29934088/f5345812c9baffe840a3ae2cad7b859601ad9e7e.gif[/img]
